follow-up time: 90 days postpartum for mothers, 28 days for neonates
outcome: Success rate of assisted vaginal birth
cohort: 104 pregnant women undergoing assisted vaginal birth using the OdonAssist device
finding: The OdonAssist device for assisted vaginal birth demonstrated a high success rate (88.5%) and a good safety profile, supporting its feasibility and efficacy as an alternative to existing methods.
mod_finding: The OdonAssist device achieved a high success rate (88.5%) for assisted vaginal births and was not associated with any serious adverse events.
